-- SCRIPT DE TORNADOS COMBINADOS (MENOR NO INÍCIO + MAIOR APÓS 5 MINUTOS)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local RootPart = Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local ID_SOM = "rbxassetid://123731555496199"

-- FUNÇÃO GERADORA DE TORNADO
local function criarTornado(config)
    local ALCANCE_SUCCAO = config.AlcanceSuccao or 50
    local FORCA_PUXAO = config.ForcaPuxao or 10
    local VELOCIDADE_TORNADO = config.Velocidade or 8
    local ALTURA_NUVENS = config.AlturaNuvens or 350
    local DISTANCIA_SPAWN = config.DistanciaSpawn or 80
    local LARGURA_BASE = config.LarguraBase or 12
    local LARGURA_TOPO = config.LarguraTopo or 200
    local QTD_BLOCOS = config.QtdBlocos or 6

    -- 1. Base do Tornado
    local posicaoInicial = RootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -DISTANCIA_SPAWN)
    local baseTornado = Instance.new("Part")
    baseTornado.Name = config.Nome or "BaseTornado"
    baseTornado.Size = Vector3.new(20, 1, 20)
    baseTornado.CFrame = CFrame.new(posicaoInicial.Position)
    baseTornado.Anchored = true
    baseTornado.CanCollide = false
    baseTornado.Transparency = 1
    baseTornado.Parent = workspace

    -- 2. Som em Loop
    local somTornado = Instance.new("Sound")
    somTornado.Name = "SomTornado"
    somTornado.SoundId = ID_SOM
    somTornado.Volume = config.Volume or 2
    somTornado.Looped = true
    somTornado.RollOffMaxDistance = config.DistanciaSom or 500
    somTornado.RollOffMinDistance = 20
    somTornado.Parent = baseTornado
    somTornado:Play()

    -- 3. Nuvens no Céu
    local nuvemSky = Instance.new("Part")
    nuvemSky.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    nuvemSky.Anchored = true
    nuvemSky.CanCollide = false
    nuvemSky.Transparency = 1
    nuvemSky.CFrame = baseTornado.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, ALTURA_NUVENS, 0)
    nuvemSky.Parent = workspace

    local attachmentNuvem = Instance.new("Attachment", nuvemSky)

    local emissorNuvem = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", attachmentNuvem)
    emissorNuvem.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
    emissorNuvem.Rate = config.TaxaFumaca or 150
    emissorNuvem.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(6, 10)
    emissorNuvem.Speed = NumberRange.new(15, 30)
    emissorNuvem.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
    emissorNuvem.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 180))
    emissorNuvem.Size = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 60),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 180),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 250)
    })
    emissorNuvem.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.6),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.2),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)
    })

    -- 4. Chuva
    local emissorChuva = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", attachmentNuvem)
    emissorChuva.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
    emissorChuva.Rate = 400
    emissorChuva.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(3, 5)
    emissorChuva.Speed = NumberRange.new(120, 180)
    emissorChuva.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
    emissorChuva.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -200, 0)
    emissorChuva.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityParallel
    emissorChuva.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(45, 45)
    emissorChuva.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(180, 210, 255))
    emissorChuva.Size = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1.5)
    })
    emissorChuva.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.6)
    })

    -- 5. Corpo do Tornado
    local attachmentBase = Instance.new("Attachment", baseTornado)
    local fumacaCorpo = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", attachmentBase)
    fumacaCorpo.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
    fumacaCorpo.Rate = config.TaxaFumaca or 220
    fumacaCorpo.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(6, 9)
    fumacaCorpo.Speed = NumberRange.new(45, 75)
    fumacaCorpo.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(10, 10)
    fumacaCorpo.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 30, 0)
    fumacaCorpo.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 190))
    fumacaCorpo.Size = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, LARGURA_BASE),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, LARGURA_TOPO * 0.45),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, LARGURA_TOPO)
    })
    fumacaCorpo.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(300, 600)

    -- 6. Blocos Voando
    local blocosVoadores = {}
    for i = 1, QTD_BLOCOS do
        local bloco = Instance.new("Part")
        bloco.Size = Vector3.new(4, 4, 4)
        bloco.Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 150, 120)
        bloco.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
        bloco.Anchored = true
        bloco.CanCollide = false
        bloco.Parent = workspace
        table.insert(blocosVoadores, {
            Objeto = bloco,
            Altura = math.random(5, 120),
            Angulo = math.random(0, 360),
            RaioGiro = math.random(15, 45)
        })
    end

    -- 7. Movimentação do Tornado
    local function getNovoDestino()
        return Vector3.new(
            baseTornado.Position.X + math.random(-600, 600),
            posicaoInicial.Position.Y,
            baseTornado.Position.Z + math.random(-600, 600)
        )
    end

    local destinoAtual = getNovoDestino()

    -- 8. Loop Principal (RenderStepped)
    local tempoSegurando = 0
    local noTornado = false
    local cooldownArremesso = 0
    local anguloJogador = 0

    local conexao = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if not baseTornado or not baseTornado.Parent then return end

        -- Mover base
        local direcao = (destinoAtual - baseTornado.Position)
        if direcao.Magnitude < 20 then
            destinoAtual = getNovoDestino()
        else
            local proximaPosicao = baseTornado.Position + (direcao.Unit * VELOCIDADE_TORNADO * dt)
            baseTornado.CFrame = CFrame.new(proximaPosicao)
        end

        nuvemSky.CFrame = baseTornado.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, ALTURA_NUVENS, 0)

        -- Animação dos blocos
        for _, dados in ipairs(blocosVoadores) do
            dados.Angulo = dados.Angulo + (4 * dt)
            dados.Altura = dados.Altura + (25 * dt)
            if dados.Altura > 200 then dados.Altura = 5 end

            local raio = (dados.Altura / 200) * dados.RaioGiro + 10
            local x = math.cos(dados.Angulo) * raio
            local z = math.sin(dados.Angulo) * raio

            dados.Objeto.CFrame = CFrame.new(baseTornado.Position + Vector3.new(x, dados.Altura, z))
        end

        -- Atração do jogador
        if RootPart and Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            local posCentro = Vector3.new(baseTornado.Position.X, 0, baseTornado.Position.Z)
            local posJogador = Vector3.new(RootPart.Position.X, 0, RootPart.Position.Z)
            local distancia = (posJogador - posCentro).Magnitude

            if cooldownArremesso > 0 then
                cooldownArremesso = cooldownArremesso - dt
            elseif distancia <= ALCANCE_SUCCAO or noTornado then
                noTornado = true
                tempoSegurando = tempoSegurando + dt
                anguloJogador = anguloJogador + (6 * dt)

                if tempoSegurando < 2 then
                    local raioGiro = (LARGURA_BASE > 20) and 28 or 15
                    local offsetX = math.cos(anguloJogador) * raioGiro
                    local offsetZ = math.sin(anguloJogador) * raioGiro
                    
                    local alvoX = baseTornado.Position.X + offsetX
                    local alvoZ = baseTornado.Position.Z + offsetZ
                    
                    RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
                        (alvoX - RootPart.Position.X) * FORCA_PUXAO,
                        20, 
                        (alvoZ - RootPart.Position.Z) * FORCA_PUXAO
                    )
                else
                    local direcaoFora = (RootPart.Position - baseTornado.Position).Unit
                    if direcaoFora.Magnitude == 0 then
                        direcaoFora = Vector3.new(math.random(-1,1), 0, math.random(-1,1)).Unit
                    end

                    local forcaArremesso = (LARGURA_BASE > 20) and 220 or 180
                    RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = (direcaoFora * forcaArremesso) + Vector3.new(0, 120, 0)
                    
                    noTornado = false
                    tempoSegurando = 0
                    cooldownArremesso = 3
                end
            else
                tempoSegurando = 0
                noTornado = false
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- 1. TORNADO MENOR (SPAWNA NA HORA)
print("🌀 Tornado Menor spawnando agora...")

    Nome = "TornadoMenor",

end)

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local char = player.Character
local backpack = player.Backpack

local function getf3x()
    for _, v in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
        if v:FindFirstChild("SyncAPI") then
            return v
        end
    end
    for _, v in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if v:FindFirstChild("SyncAPI") then
            return v
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local f3x = getf3x()
if not f3x then
    warn("you dont have f3x skid")
    return
end

local syncapi = f3x.SyncAPI
local serverendpoint = syncapi.ServerEndpoint

local function delete(part)
    local args = {[1] = "Remove",[2] = {[1] = part}}
    serverendpoint:InvokeServer(unpack(args))
end

local function deleteall()
    for _, v in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("BasePart") or v:IsA("UnionOperation") then
            task.spawn(function()
                delete(v)
            end)
        end
    end
end

deleteall()

local function resize(part, size, cf)
    local args = {[1] = "SyncResize",[2] = {[1] = {["Part"] = part, ["CFrame"] = cf, ["Size"] = size}}}
    serverendpoint:InvokeServer(unpack(args))
end

local function syncmaterial(part, mate)
    local args = {[1] = "SyncMaterial",[2] = {[1] = {["Part"] = part, ["Material"] = mate}}}
    serverendpoint:InvokeServer(unpack(args))
end

local function transparency(part, trans)
    local args = {[1] = "SyncMaterial",[2] = {[1] = {["Part"] = part, ["Transparency"] = trans}}}
    serverendpoint:InvokeServer(unpack(args))
end

local function color(part, col)
    local args = {[1] = "SyncColor",[2] = {[1] = {["Part"] = part, ["Color"] = col, ["UnionColoring"] = false}}}
    serverendpoint:InvokeServer(unpack(args))
end

local function syncmeshid(part, id)
    local args = {[1] = "SyncMesh",[2] = {[1] = {["Part"] = part, ["MeshId"] = "rbxassetid://"..id}}}
    serverendpoint:InvokeServer(unpack(args))
end

    serverendpoint:InvokeServer(unpack(args))

    serverendpoint:InvokeServer(unpack(args))

    serverendpoint:InvokeServer(unpack(args))
end

    serverendpoint:InvokeServer(unpack(args))

    serverendpoint:InvokeServer(unpack(args))

    serverendpoint:InvokeServer(unpack(args))

    serverendpoint:InvokeServer(unpack(args))
end

    serverendpoint:InvokeServer(unpack(args))

    surfaceGui.PixelsPerStud = 40

    local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    textLabel.Text = textString
    textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    textLabel.TextScaled = true
    textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    textLabel.Parent = surfaceGui
    
    surfaceGui.Parent = part
end

local function makerealmbase()
    local position = CFrame.new(0, 5, 0)
    local base = serverendpoint:InvokeServer("CreatePart", "Normal", position, workspace)
    resize(base, Vector3.new(512, 16, 512), position)
    syncmaterial(base, Enum.Material.Concrete)
    color(base, Color3.new(0.513725, 0.513725, 0.513725))

-- Load the Rayfield UI Library
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

-- 1. UI Configuration
local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "Xozich hub",
    LoadingTitle = "Xozich hub Loading...",
    LoadingSubtitle = "by Roblox_Deniska0",
    ConfigurationSaving = {
        Enabled = false,
        FolderName = nil,
        FileName = "XozichHub"
    },
    Discord = {
        Enabled = false,
    },
    KeySystem = false,
    KeySettings = {
        Title = "Untitled",
        Subtitle = "Key System",
        Note = "No method of obtaining the key is provided",
        FileName = "Key",
        SaveKey = true,
        Key = {"Hello"}
    }
})

-- Create the "Auto Farm" tab
local AutoFarmTab = Window:CreateTab("Auto Farm", nil) -- nil is the icon (no icon)

-- Variables for loop control and thread management
local isAutoFarming = false
local autoFarmThread = nil

-- 2 & 3. Core Functionality & Death/Respawn Protection
local function autoFarmLoop()
    local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    
    while isAutoFarming do
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        -- Death & Respawn Protection Check
        -- If the character is gone, dead, or HumanoidRootPart is missing, wait for respawn
        if not character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not hrp then
            -- Wait for the player to fully respawn
            character = player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
            humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
            hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        end

        -- Search the entire Workspace for parts named exactly "Template"
        for _, obj in pairs(game.Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            -- Re-check if the loop was stopped while iterating
            if not isAutoFarming then break end

            -- Also re-check health/HRP during the fast loop to prevent errors if player dies mid-iteration
            if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not hrp or not hrp.Parent then
                break -- Break out of the for-loop to return to the outer while-loop, triggering respawn handling
            end

            -- If the object is a BasePart and is named exactly "Template"
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name == "Template" then
                -- Teleport to the Template part with a 3-stud vertical offset
                hrp.CFrame = obj.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0)
                
                -- 1 millisecond delay (fastest possible execution)
                task.wait(0.001) 
            end
        end
        
        -- Small fallback wait to prevent script exhaustion if no "Template" parts are found
        task.wait()
    end
end

-- 4. UI Elements & Controls

-- Start Auto Farm Button
local StartButton = AutoFarmTab:CreateButton({
    Name = "Start Auto Farm",
    Callback = function()
        -- Prevent multiple loops from running simultaneously
        if isAutoFarming then
            Rayfield:Notify({
                Title = "Xozich hub",
                Content = "Auto Farm is already running!",
                Duration = 3,
            })
            return
        end

        -- Activate flag and notify
        isAutoFarming = true
        Rayfield:Notify({
            Title = "Xozich hub",
            Content = "Auto Farm Started!",
            Duration = 3,
        })

        -- Spawn the loop in a separate thread to prevent UI freezing
        autoFarmThread = task.spawn(autoFarmLoop)
    end,
})

-- Stop Auto Farm Button
